## Checklist

- [ ] Frontend and backend builds pass where affected.
- [ ] Tests pass and cover changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.
- [ ] No secrets, personal codeplugs, or generated artifacts are committed.
- [ ] Existing architecture and dependency direction are preserved.
- [ ] An ADR was created or updated when the decision has lasting impact.
- [ ] Radio-format claims are backed by sanitized, reproducible evidence.
